notes: Rotate or mirror a set of marks and get a copy - for wings and opposite-hand units.

features: Rotate or mirror marks into a copy: tick layers (or lasso marks) and use the new arrow buttons - mirror left-right, mirror top-bottom, rotate 90 either way, or 180. The originals stay put and the copy is added, for a wing or opposite-hand unit that repeats the same devices flipped.
A transform of 200 marks or more asks first and tells you the before/after total, so a whole job can't be doubled by a stray click.
